headline: Manna stochastic sandpile 1991 (CA / SOC, disclosed): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; fitted tau=1.262 (s_min=1), nonzero sizes span 4.6 decades (max/median=1945x), stationary mean occupancy=0.699

verdicts.gate: P1 discrete-MLE tail exponent tau in [1.2, 1.4] (Manna-class avalanche exponent, Manna 2D tau~1.27)
P2 heavy-tailed: nonzero sizes span >= 2.0 decades AND max >= 100.0x median nonzero
P3 stationary mean occupancy in [0.6, 0.95] (finite active density: a genuine critical steady state)

extra.fit_method: exact discrete power-law MLE (Hurwitz-zeta likelihood; Clauset, Shalizi & Newman 2009) solved by Brent root-find on the score, lower cutoff s_min=1
extra.model_class: stochastic cellular automaton / self-organized criticality (NOT agent-stepping ABM): a STOCHASTIC toppling rule is applied to a grid of integer heights; there are no agents, no scheduler, no per-agent decisions
extra.distinctness: the RANDOM two-grain redistribution (each toppling scatters its 2 grains to two INDEPENDENTLY-random von-Neumann neighbours) puts this in the Manna (conserved directed-percolation) universality class, distinct from the deterministic BTW sandpile (fixed 4 neighbours, threshold 4) and from the non-conservative OFC earthquake model
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic CA/SOC result; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Manna SOC power-law (tau~1.27) and would catch an artifact (e.g. a non-power-law, a wrong exponent, or a frozen/drained lattice)

citations: Manna, S. S. (1991). Two-state model of self-organized criticality. J. Phys. A: Math. Gen. 24:L363-L369. doi:10.1088/0305-4470/24/7/009.
Clauset, A., Shalizi, C.R. & Newman, M.E.J. (2009). Power-law distributions in empirical data. SIAM Review 51(4):661-703 (discrete-MLE estimator).

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction. The canonical 2D Manna exponent tau~1.27 serves as the literature anchor (P1).
